Bench: Rajendra Prakash Soni [2024:RJ-JD:41340]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 11414/2024 Rama Ram S/o Phusa Ram, Aged About 55 Years, R/o Kosriya, At Present Bhimarlal, P.s. Pachpadra, Dist. Balotra  (Lodged In Sub Jail, Balotra)
 ----Petition  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ramesh Siyag For Respondent(s) : Mr. Urja Ram Kalbi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI Order 09/10/2024 1.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Through this bail application, accused has come before this Court for grant of bail under section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of the old Code) in connection with crime registered pursuant to First Information Report No.342/2022 of Police Station Pachpadra, District Barmer in respect of offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. I have considered the rival submissions of learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned Public Prosecutor and perused the record.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor for the State has strongly objected the different submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant and submitted that in the facts of the present case, it is expedient that accused be kept in the custody.
He thus, craves rejection of the applicant's bail application.
4. I have given my anxious consideration to the rival submissions with reference to material placed before me.

[2024:RJ-JD:41340] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-11414/2024]

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On perusal of the record and upon consideration of the submissions, it would be clear that allegation against the petitioner is of cheating and forgery.
The amount involved is not significant.
The petitioner is in custody since 30.08.2024.
The case is exclusively triable by Magistrate court and trial of the case will take sufficient time to conclude.
Therefore, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case for grant of indulgence of bail to the petitioner.

6. Consequently, the present bail application is allowed and it is directed that the accused-petitioner Rama Ram S/o Phusa Ram, arrested in connection with the F.I.R. No.342/2022 of Police Station Pachpadra, District Barmer shall be released on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond and two surety bonds of sufficient amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

This order is subject to the condition that accused, within 7 days of his release, and sureties on the day of furnishing bail, will also furnish details of their all bank accounts, with bank and branch name, in shape of an affidavit, and submit legible copy of their Aadhar cards as well as copy of front page of Bank pass book, for smooth recovery of penalty amount, if there arise a need for recovery of penalty under Section 446 Cr.P.C in future.
(RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI),J 103-Payal/-
